meta.note: Neutral Cardano ecosystem timeline markers. Observability, not attribution — events are dated facts, never claimed to have caused any market move.

events.title: Byron mainnet launch
events.description: Cardano mainnet launched (Byron era); ADA became transferable.

events.title: Catalyst Fund 0 (test)
events.description: Initial test fund before public funding.

events.title: Shelley hard fork
events.description: Transition to Shelley ledger rules; staking and delegation introduced.

events.title: Catalyst Fund 2
events.description: First broadly public fund with community proposals.

events.title: Catalyst Fund 3
events.description: Funding round with on-chain community voting.

events.title: Allegra hard fork
events.description: Token-locking / timelock support added (prerequisite for native tokens).

events.title: Mary hard fork (native tokens)
events.description: Native multi-asset tokens and NFTs enabled on the ledger.

events.title: Alonzo hard fork (smart contracts)
events.description: Plutus smart contracts enabled (on-chain scripts / dApps).

events.title: Vasil hard fork
events.description: Plutus V2, reference inputs, diffusion pipelining (Babbage era).

events.title: Catalyst Funds 10-12
events.description: Funding rounds through 2023-2024.

events.title: Chang #1 (Conway era begins)
events.description: Conway ledger era; initial on-chain governance scaffolding (DRep registration, vote delegation).

events.title: Conway governance era begins
events.description: On-chain governance activated: DRep registration, vote delegation, initial action set.

events.title: Catalyst Fund 13 voting snapshot
events.description: Voting-power snapshot taken; voting and results followed.

events.title: Plomin hard fork (Chang #2)
events.description: Full Conway on-chain governance activated, including treasury voting.

events.title: Full ADA-holder governance active
events.description: Full Conway action set (treasury withdrawals, no-confidence, CC updates) votable.

events.title: Cardano Constitution ratified (v1)
events.description: First official Constitution ratified and enacted on-chain.

events.title: 2025 Net Change Limit adopted
events.description: Treasury net-withdrawal limit (~350M ADA) set for the defined epoch window.

events.title: Catalyst Fund 14
events.description: Proposal submission and voting in 2025.

events.title: Cardano Critical Integrations (CCI V1) withdrawal
events.description: Treasury withdrawal of 70,000,000 ADA approved under the CCI budget.

events.title: Catalyst Fund 15 (current)
events.description: Current fund per the official fund timeline.

events.title: Updated Cardano Constitution effective
events.description: Updated Constitution took effect; governance-action structure refined.

events.title: jpg.store enters restriction mode
events.description: New listings/offers/lending/minting disabled; purchases and repayments still possible.

events.title: jpg.store final shutdown
events.description: jpg.store and Comet ceased operations.

events.title: Cardano Summit 2026 treasury funding vote falls short
events.description: A treasury funding proposal (~7.8M ADA, revised down from ~14.07M) for Cardano Summit 2026 reached ~65% of DRep stake, short of the ~two-thirds threshold for treasury actions; a headcount majority (135 for, 61 against, 24 abstaining) and the Constitutional Committee were in favor. The Summit was cancelled; a separate TOKEN2049 sponsorship proposal passed.

events.title: TapTools announces wind-down
events.description: TapTools announced it would wind down operations over roughly two weeks.

events.title: Van Rossem hard fork (v11) — initiation submitted
events.description: HardForkInitiation to Protocol Version 11 ("van Rossem") submitted on-chain 2026-06-16; in DRep/SPO/CC voting and awaiting ratification (expires epoch 644, ~2026-07-18) as of epoch 642. Not yet ratified or enacted. Would update the Plutus cost model and add new cryptographic built-ins. Named for governance contributor Max van Rossem.

events.title: EMURGO steps down from the Pentad
events.description: EMURGO formally notified the other Cardano governing entities that it would step down from its duties as a member of the Pentad, stating its immediate priority was the SecondFi recovery process.

events.title: SecondFi wallet permanent shutdown
events.description: EMURGO announced the permanent shutdown of the SecondFi wallet (formerly Yoroi); it will not resume after a June 2026 exploit that left users' private keys derivable from on-chain data (374 wallets, ~16M ADA affected). Remaining activity limited to asset recovery and user migration.
